criterion_fired: Criterion 1 (Complete Coverage), Criterion 2 (Carry-forward Consistency), Criterion 4 (Actionable Next Steps)
suggested_change: Criterion 1: Define mutually exclusive status options—'Unknown' (no progress toward identification, 1-3/10), 'Partial' (named user group or department with 4-7/10), 'Identified' (named individual with 8-10/10). Criterion 2: Require explicit rationale in rubric when scores decline between calls ('No new data' vs. 'Previous assessment was too generous'). Criterion 4: Clarify that '[Contact TBD]' satisfies specificity only if paired with concrete deadline and WHAT question to ask; 'on next call, ask' alone is insufficient.
